verdict.rationale: The official docs show one-line conversion commands such as `magick input.png -quality 85 output.webp` across 200+ formats. The project describes a scripting-first CLI design for mass batch jobs, and the CLI has a documented command-line reference page. Community reports independently confirm scripted bash batch use and praise its short one-liners. Missing for 10: explicit CI-specific evidence (e.g., CI pipeline usage docs or a hands-on report of use in CI).
